notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two lands.
You have at least two instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Dark Petition by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands to your hand from the battlefield, copying Dark Petition.
Resolve the copy of Dark Petition, causing you to search your library for a card, put it into your hand and add {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two lands onto the battlefield tapped from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
